about: Curated isometric-world overlay exported from the v9 mockup (work/world-mockup/world-v9.html): every built machine. Keyed by OpenAlex work ids: it only applies when the active dataset contains these papers. cell = tile offset from the island centre; ring 0 centre, 1 ring-1, 2 ring-2; live = the machine's module ships with the app (otherwise the world shows its thumbnail and a render-pending state).
